how_these_were_chosen: The date-plus-index rule the arc has used since E09: 2026-08-13, runs 51 and 52. allocation.2026081351: seed 1 — run on A1 and on A2, so the arms differ in reference modality and in nothing else.
allocation.2026081352: seed 2 — run on A1 and on A2, same pairing. Two seeds per arm because this tier's worlds are model-decided, so world claims WILL arise and a scene observation from one seed is an observation, never a route property (E10 closing ruling R3).

the_pairing_is_the_point: Four submissions, two seeds, two arms, every seed appearing once in each arm. The one variable between A1 and A2 is what sits in the reference slot; if the seeds differed across arms, every difference in the outputs would be two variables wide and the comparison the spec exists to make would not exist.
what_pinned_means_on_this_tier: Wan2ReferenceVideoApi carries `seed` as a plain INT input (get_node, re-measured 2026-08-13) with no `control_after_generate` in API format. In API format a seed is pinned when it is a literal, which is how these are sent. In SAVE format the widget may exist, and route_gates.seeds() reads it there — which is why this tier is taught to SEED_NODES and SEED_INPUTS in the same commit that first submits it, rather than left as a class the seed table does not know. Before that teaching, Gate S on an r2v graph would have reported '0 noise-bearing seed(s), all pinned' having checked nothing: the vacuous shape the halt-era executor was ruled right to refuse.
what_a_pinned_seed_does_NOT_promise_here: This is a hosted partner tier. A pinned seed makes the SUBMISSION reproducible as a request; it does not establish that the provider's generation is deterministic, and no run in this repo has measured that. CLAUDE.md's law stands: where a provider is nondeterministic, the record says so, and no repeat-variance floor has been measured on wan2.7-r2v. Nothing in E13 quotes a difference against an unmeasured floor.

ceiling.note: FOUR submissions total — the branch the Stage-0 cascade probe selected before any submission, recorded in docs/experiments/E13-run-report.md §3. Bracket 424-844 credits at the re-estimated 106-211 per generation; HALT above 900 (did not fire). No re-runs: a fired gate ends the run where it stands. Spent credits have no compensator, so the bound is the honest treatment.
ceiling.why_machine_readable: The value was free prose and no tool under tools/ read the key, while `seeds` and `allocation` — its machine-readable siblings — are both consumed and gated. CLAUDE.md makes the credit ceiling a per-spec obligation and records that spent credits have no compensator, so the one unrecoverable resource in this repo was bounded by a string nothing could parse. The prose is not deleted: it is `note`, verbatim, and the number a submission step can count against sits beside it. CORRECTION, 2026-09-04 (swarm wave 8, F-6c5c537b). This paragraph used to argue the fix with the clause “while `seeds` and `allocation` — its machine-readable siblings — are both consumed and gated”, and to close “and the number a submission step can count against sits beside it”. Both halves were measured on the tree and only one survived. `grep -rn allocation tools/ --include=*.py` returns 0 hits: `allocation` has no reader at all, so it is exactly as unread as `ceiling` was when it was filed. `seeds` has seven readers — build_animate_payload.py:691 (main), build_camera_i2v_payload.py:1257 (main), build_i2v_payload.py:859 (main), build_lora_arm_payload.py:532 (gate_s), build_r2v_payload.py:360 (build_and_write), build_t2v_payload.py:549 (main) and gate_saved_graph.py:1267 (main) — each handing the list to a seed gate, so that half of the claim holds. And no tool reads `ceiling` from a seeds spec either: every `ceiling` hit under tools/ is `armature_core.assembly`'s unrelated CASCADE slot ceiling, or a builder passing that one. So `ceiling.submissions` is a number a submission step COULD count against and none does today — the bound is held by the spec and the executor, not by code. The original claim is kept above rather than deleted, because the correction is more useful than the original. tests/test_seeds_specs.py pins the measurement; the day a builder counts against `ceiling.submissions`, that test flips with it and this paragraph is rewritten again. binds_in_both_directions: An experiment that pre-registered seeds must use one of them, and an experiment that pre-registered none may not vary its seed at all. route_gates.gate_s_registration enforces both clauses against the saved file the cloud converts, and it can only do so on this tier because SEED_NODES now names the class.
